box.implementationNotes: Concept art only. For a final 3D carton use the actual brand wordmark texture, separate lid/flaps and high-resolution surface print. Universal teaser should not imply a specific collection or leak the result's rarity.

audio.sourceProcessing: Original generated MP3 bytes retained. Review copies byte-identical; no trimming, resynthesis, gain edits or conversion. Analysis WAVs only for integrity checks.

entries.prompt: A small premium cardboard toy carton shakes: 0 to 0.8 seconds three playful dry papery rattles and soft toy knocks, accelerating. At 0.8 seconds a crisp lid flap opens and a round cushioned pop. Then a warm two-note glass chime and tiny sparkle, fading fully to silence. Close clean studio foley, joyful tactile mobile game reveal. No voices, speech, music bed, coins, casino or harsh highs.

A small premium cardboard toy carton shakes: 0 to 1.2 seconds accelerating dry paper rattles and soft toy knocks. At 1.2 seconds a crisp lid flap bursts open with a round pop and airy bright whoosh. A joyful rising glass-bell flourish blooms into shimmering celebratory sparkles, then a full soft decay to silence. Close clean mobile game foley. No voice, speech, music bed, coins, casino, brass or harsh highs.

timing.currentSoundStarts: Opened callback at pop; no shake-start sound hook
timing.proposal: Start shake foley with opening gesture; trigger the selected reveal ending at the actual saved-result pop event. Rarer result keeps a full celebration tail. Do not play common and special together. Calm/Skip must suppress the shake and avoid replaying an entire delayed shake cue.
timing.auditionCaveat: Prompts specify pop timing targets. Human listening and animation alignment remain to verify; a full generated take is not a production-ready event-aligned stem.
